patch_differential.evidence: Identical PoC (63 20 00). VUL: double-free abort, RC=1. FIX: 'usable protocols: any' / 'chosen protocol: OpenFlow10-table_id' / 'Execution successful', RC=0, no AddressSanitizer output. Fix commit 4d1ca70 deletes the redundant minimatch_destroy(&fm.match) at ofctl_parse_target.c:65. vul_crashes && fix_clean => that line is the root cause.

R3_vulnerable_function_reached.evidence: ASan crash stack frame #2 and freed_by frame #2 both show ofctl_parse_flow (tests/oss-fuzz/ofctl_parse_target.c) executing the destroy path.

R4_vulnerable_line_reached.evidence: ASan crash stack frame #2: 'ofctl_parse_flow /src/openvswitch/tests/oss-fuzz/ofctl_parse_target.c:65:9' — the redundant minimatch_destroy(&fm.match) (root_cause line) is reached and executed as the second free.
